faq.title: Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi
faq.q1: Me ya sa ake buƙatar tabbatar da asalina?
faq.a1: Dokokin duniya suna buƙatar haka ga duk canja wurin — na mutum (P2P) da kasuwanci (B2B). Bridge (MSB a FinCEN, Amurka) yana yin sa, ba OmniPay ba. Sau ɗaya kawai.
faq.q2: Canja wurin kuɗi yana ɗaukar lokaci nawa?
faq.a2: Canja wurin mutum ɗaya (P2P): Kusan nan take — Bridge yana sarrafa biyan kuɗi zuwa kowanne ƙasa daga cikin ƙasashe 41+ a cikin mintoci kaɗan. Biyan kuɗi na kasuwanci (B2B): kwanaki 4–5 na aiki (Stripe+Wise) ko 1–2 kwana (Bridge Wire).
faq.q3: Shin OmniPay tana adana bayanana na banki?
faq.a3: A'a — ba ga canja wurin mutum ɗaya ba ko na kasuwanci. Bridge kawai yana sarrafa su da ɓoye bayanai AES-256.
faq.q4: Me zai faru idan na rufe shafin bayan KYC?
faq.a4: P2P: Koma zuwa hanyar haɗin asali — tsarin zai ci gaba ta atomatik. B2B: haka nan.
faq.a5: P2P: OmniPay 0.50% + $0.49 · Bridge ~0.75% · Babu ƙarin FX. B2B Stripe+Wise: Stripe 2.9% + Wise ~0.5% + OmniPay 1%. Farashin kasuwa na gaske.
faq.q6: Menene zai faru idan an sami kuskure na fasaha yayin canja wurin kuɗi?
faq.a6: Idan tsarin ya gaza kafin Bridge ya tabbatar da biyan kuɗi na ƙarshe, ana mayar da kuɗin zuwa ga mai aika ta atomatik. Babu wani abu da yake rataye a tsakiya: Bridge ba ta saki kuɗi sai ta tabbatar cewa mai karɓa ya samu daidai. Idan matsalar ta ci gaba, tuntubi taimakonmu daga shafin gida.
